prompt_en: A complex photographic test scene centers on a portrait subject who pauses for a staged photograph. She is an unmistakably adult woman in a small coastal railway signal museum before opening, beside a demonstration board whose bolted support bracket now stands upright. The attached image supplies appearance guidance. Her short dark bob, wispy bangs, softly rounded oval face, brown eyes and softly full lips follow the visible face-and-hair reference. She meets the lens with a small relieved smile, wearing a bronze sleeveless satin blouse and slate tailored trousers; gentle side light gives her relaxed presence a subtle intimate appeal. She holds a half-kneeling pose: her right knee rests on a cork pad on the floor, her right shin extends backward, and her left foot is planted flat forward with the left knee raised. Her pelvis stays lifted above the rear heel and her torso is upright over the knee-and-foot base. Both elbows are comfortably bent and each hand is raised beside its own shoulder, separated from her face. Her right hand makes an OK sign: thumb tip touches index-finger tip in a closed round loop facing the lens, while the middle, ring and little fingers extend separately. Her left hand makes a V sign: index and middle fingers extend upward and separate into a V, while the ring and little fingers fold into the palm beneath the thumb. A brass tide gauge and a rolled coastal chart sit on a low workbench behind her, explaining this railway's tidal crossing display. Low side-window light lays silver reflections across the polished floor. A straight frontal camera at her low eye height gives a tight environmental full-body portrait, including both hands, the grounded knee and the planted foot, with clear finger silhouettes and quiet museum depth.
